expected.subject: John, quick note from Legora
expected.body:
Hi John,

I'm with Legora, the legal AI platform for Litigation used by partners at Goodwin and White & Case.

As Chairman and CEO, you're probably still spending too much time overseeing associates manually reviewing pleadings, discovery documents, and case law deal after deal.

I'd love to share the use cases that other attorneys are using heavily for similar work in your practice area and hear your thoughts.

Would you be interested in seeing a brief demo?

William
Legora

notes: Based on proven US BDR template. Litigation Chairman & CEO. Practice-specific pain (pleadings, discovery). Soft demo ask, no link.
